_comment: Super Pixel in-development module — Voice Recognition AI. For leads captured via a click-to-call or voice step, a short voice sample is analyzed to detect voice-actor fraud (the same actor reused across many 'different' leads) and synthetic/AI voices. Not every lead has a voice sample. `verdict` = 'human_unique' | 'human_reused_actor' | 'synthetic' | null (no sample).

L-1009.notes: Same voiceprint submitted under 4 different names/numbers in 30 days — voice-actor fraud.
